sources.retainingWall.sliding: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.16 (p. 802) and Sec 3.14 (p. 801): 1.5 against sliding
sources.retainingWall.overturning: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.16 (p. 802) and Sec 3.14 (p. 800): 1.5 against overturning
sources.retainingWall.seismic: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.14 and 3.16 (pp. 800-802): 1.5, no reduction with earthquake
sources.retainingWall.passive: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.14(i) (p. 801): passive resistance is not counted where the abutting soil could be removed by excavation; counted in full only where the wall states that it cannot
sources.retainingWall.flotation: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.2(a)(iii) (p. 727): 0.9 x Dead Load + Buoyancy Pressure, i.e. 0.9 W >= U
sources.retainingWall.baseFriction: SAEngine practice, not BNBC: tan(r φ'), used only when the pack gives no friction coefficient
sources.retainingWall.adhesion: SAEngine practice, not BNBC: used only when the pack gives no friction coefficient
sources.retainingWall.yieldingKh: SAEngine practice, not BNBC (AASHTO LRFD 11.6.5.2.2: kh = 0.5 kh0 for a wall free to move 25-50 mm)
sources.strutAndTie: ACI 318-19 Tables 23.4.3, 23.9.2, Secs 23.2.7, 23.5.1 (the procedure BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.4.6 sends deep members to; φ in BNBC Sec 6.2.3.2, p. 897); tieArm is SAEngine practice
sources.retainingWall.frictionCoefficient: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.14(iii) (p. 801): friction factor 0.5; a greater value only if verified by analysis and test
sources.shallow.bearingCombinations: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.2(a) (p. 727); Normal Live Load reduced as in column design (Sec 2.3.13)
sources.shallow.lateralIncrease: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.3 and 3.9.3.2 (p. 728): 33% with wind or earthquake, none for gravity loads alone
sources.shallow.factorOfSafety: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.3 (p. 728): 2.0 to 3.0 on the bearing capacity
sources.shallow.kern: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.1 (p. 727): resultant preferably within B/6 of the centre
sources.shallow.sliding: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.14 (p. 801): 1.5 against sliding; (i) no passive where the soil could be removed; (ii) no base friction under pile-supported structures
sources.shallow.minDepth: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.8.2(d) (p. 723): 500 mm below natural ground level unless rock or other weather resistant material is at the surface
sources.shallow.exteriorDepth: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.8.6 (p. 725): exterior footings of permanent structures 1.5 m in cohesive and 2 m in cohesionless soil, 400 mm for temporary ones; more on expansive soil
sources.shallow.raftDepth: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.8.10 (p. 726): 1.5 m in cohesive and 2 m in cohesionless soil
sources.shallow.slopeDistance: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.8.2 and 3.18 (pp. 724, 806): twice the footing width
sources.shallow.spreadAngle: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.8.2 (p. 723): masonry 1/2, lime concrete 2/3, cement concrete 1 horizontal to 1 vertical (fractions read on the PDF page)
sources.shallow.stepLap: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.8.2 and 3.18 (pp. 724, 806): the thickness of the foundation or three times the step height, whichever is greater
sources.shallow.minThickness: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.8.3 (p. 724) and Sec 6.8.7 (p. 978): RC 150 mm above the bottom bars on soil, 300 mm on piles; plain concrete 200 mm; masonry 250 mm
sources.shallow.presumptive: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.3.1 and Table 6.3.7 (pp. 728-729): two storeys or less in occupancy A-D, or the preliminary design of any structure
sources.shallow.subgrade: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.6.3 and Tables 6.3.9a-b (pp. 736-737): 300 mm plate, preliminary design
sources.shallow.settlementLimits: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.4.7(d) and Table 6.3.8 (pp. 732-733), a guide
sources.shallow.settlementGuide: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.9.4.7(d) (p. 732): isolated pad footings
